issue.title: SSL connection not closed properly after handshake failure

repository.name: netty
repository.description: Netty project - an event-driven asynchronous network application framework

issue.body:
Motivation:

When SSL handshake fails, the connection should be closed. This is not true anymore after 978a46c.

Modifications:

- Ensure we always flush and close the channel on handshake failure.
- Add testcase.

Result:

Fixes [#7724].

body: @jianglai no problem... would be nice if you can verify the fix

Confirmed that with 4.1.22.Final-SNAPSHOT, the demo code works as intended.

Thanks!
